exports.name: find_escape
exports.signature: pub fn find_escape(bytes: &[u8], policy: EscapePolicy) -> Option<usize>
exports.behavior: Finds the first mandatory or policy-selected escape byte in arbitrary byte slices without UTF-8 validation or index narrowing. Uses capability-checked AVX2 or AArch64 NEON discovery with bounded loads and a scalar fallback.

exports.name: escaped_length
exports.signature: pub fn escaped_length(text: &str, policy: EscapePolicy) -> Result<u32>
exports.behavior: Computes the exact serialized content length without wrapper quotes. Uses the same run traversal and scalar spelling as emission. Input and output size overflow return PayloadTooLarge from Encode at u32::MAX.

exports.name: write_escaped
exports.signature: pub fn write_escaped(text: &str, policy: EscapePolicy, sink: &mut dyn ByteSink) -> Result<()>
exports.behavior: Checks input and complete content output sizes, reserves the exact append size, and emits borrowed UTF-8 runs plus stack-encoded JSON escapes. Preserves sink error metadata and permits an emitted prefix on write failure.

exports.name: write_string
exports.signature: pub fn write_string(text: &str, policy: EscapePolicy, sink: &mut dyn ByteSink) -> Result<()>
exports.behavior: Checks content plus both wrapper quotes against the u32 ABI limit and reserves the entire append before emitting the opening quote. Applies mandatory short escapes, lowercase Unicode hex, optional solidus escaping, and optional ASCII-only UTF-16 surrogate pairs.

unsafe_justifications.justification: Calls a private unsafe function pointer selected only by EscapeFinder::new. Native targets are installed only after fresh jmax_dispatch capability detection confirms usable CPU and OS state. The scalar target has no feature requirement. Every target independently bounds loads for the actual provided slice, including slices shorter than the selection hint. No caller-provided capabilities or search pointers are accepted by public APIs.

Architecture-gated AVX2 target-feature function is reachable only through the checked finder. Each unaligned 32-byte load is guarded by bytes.len() - cursor >= 32, cursor advances only by complete vector widths, and all remaining bytes use scalar discovery. Unsigned control comparisons exclude non-ASCII bytes unless ascii_only selects them.

Architecture-gated AArch64 NEON target-feature function is reachable only through the checked finder. Each 16-byte load is guarded by bytes.len() - cursor >= 16. Match vectors are stored only into a local 16-byte array and searched in memory order, avoiding endian-dependent mask packing. Remaining bytes use scalar discovery.
